hypothesis: tornado.escape.xhtml_escape does not escape single quotes, so a single-quoted HTML attribute containing a value with an apostrophe is not safely escaped.
trigger: Call tornado.escape.xhtml_escape("'") and assert that the result contains no raw apostrophe character.
potential_failure: xhtml_escape returns "'" unchanged, leaving a raw single quote that can break out of single-quoted HTML attributes.

oracle.expected_behavior: xhtml_escape should escape single quotes (e.g. to ' or ') so that the output is safe for use in single-quoted HTML attributes.
oracle.target_evidence: tornado/escape.py defines xhtml_escape and its docstring says it escapes a string so it can be safely inserted into HTML; the implementation uses a translation table that maps &, <, >, and " but not '.
